result_summary: Recovered the missing Prometeo mobile capability-reuse map. The surface is a logical composition over the existing Universal Host: reuse V5 for served shell/control/capture behavior, consume shared Capture/Context Foundry/Page Change Thread/worker mechanisms under their existing authority classes, and treat PageKit as a donor pattern rather than a mobile product owner. No second mobile shell, Prompt OS, Context Foundry or Worker Fabric was proposed.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: current vs candidate vs historical truth separated
at least one non-obvious finding or explicit no-finding
next work deduplicated against active queues

key_findings: Prometeo mobile should compose over the already-served single Universal Host rather than fork a second global/mobile shell.
Prompt OS/Context Foundry and Worker Fabric historical vocabulary already has verified current descendants/shared owners; mobile must consume them rather than revive parallel control planes.
The candidate surface registry route state lags the later truth return: this is a reconciliation/freshness delta, not evidence for inventing a new page_id or route.
PageKit and shared Capture bytes are donor/component evidence, not product-level authority; lifecycle/owner contracts outrank names and directories.

deduplication.reason: All shared capability families already have owners or active lanes; only the declared mobile planner dependency remains missing before local integration.
